scope: Transactional manual edits and retained-scene preparation, source ownership, power and startup restoration

contracts: Manual transition commands and fader binding preserve driver, recall, revision and providers when capacity is exhausted.
Pause/remove/blend/opacity/input edits and slot/layer STOP/RESET reserve retained scenes before mutation.
Transition selection, layer reset/replacement and slot/preset activation reserve retained scopes before committing.
Removing the hidden source scene excludes its demand from admission.
Direct-to-composition promotion and subsequent reset preserve declarations.
Standalone transition programs own scoped input providers and release them on replacement.
Power off releases demand; power on and restore_last reboot restore declarations and only active references.
Superseded queued resets release retained source scopes and return to the original heap usage.

ram.dynamic_costs: lwIP pools are static; driver budget covers pio0/pio1 at the compiled pixel capacity; dynamic output/config/pin records and other native allocations use operating headroom

remaining: remaining multi-rate/threshold and transport conformance cases
short Sense/Pico subscription checks and configuration restore
